concepts.gloss_en: being able to pray, sing, and give thanks to God (through gathering good points)

reason_for_human: Both occurrences are the same phrase in the same teaching (lm1:282) about how gathering good points enables one to pray, sing, and thank God. The only difference is verbal inflection (יוכל future vs יכול present) of the root יכל — same word, same concept, not a homograph.
